plainTranslation: Directly opposing drives. You want the same intensity aimed in opposite directions - magnetic and exhausting. Failure mode: every difference becomes a contest. Take turns leading, agree on direction first, and stop treating the relationship as a fight to win.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Your drives keep clashing, wanting to move different ways at once. Friction, competition, and heat. Aim the fight at a shared task, not at each other.
tension: The harder part is that ordinary decisions can turn into a tug of war. You want to go one way, they want to go another. You want movement, they want control. They may feel rushed by you, while you may feel blocked by them. Before long, the issue is no longer the plan. It is who gets to decide the pace.
advice: Do not make the other person's way of acting into the enemy. Decide what you are trying to accomplish first. Once you know the goal, the two different approaches can work together instead of pulling the relationship apart.
summaryShort: Your drives keep clashing, wanting to move different ways at once.
